## Data Layer

**Path: `/bench/repo/store`**

This is the [Memos](https://github.com/usememos/memos) project — module `github.com/usememos/memos`. The `store` package is the data layer: it defines the entity structs and a `Driver` interface (`/bench/repo/store/driver.go`) implemented per-database under `/bench/repo/store/db/{sqlite,mysql,postgres}`.

## Project language & structure

- **Language:** Go (primary backend), with a TypeScript/React frontend under `/bench/repo/web` (separate `package.json` — effectively a two-part repo: Go backend + JS frontend).
- **Backend layout:** `cmd/` (entrypoint), `server/` (API/gRPC), `store/` (data layer), `internal/` (supporting libs), `proto/` (protobuf-generated types).
- Not a Go-multi-module monorepo — single `go.mod` at root. The web frontend is the only other package.

## How entities are defined (framework/pattern)

There is **no ORM**. Persistence uses **plain Go structs + hand-written SQL** dispatched through a `Driver` interface with three concrete implementations (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL) in `/bench/repo/store/db/`. Struct fields have **no ORM tags/decorators** (fields like `ID int32`, `CreatedTs int64` map to columns positionally in the SQL, not via annotations). Some fields hold protobuf message types from `proto/gen/store` (e.g. `Payload *storepb.MemoPayload`).

The authoritative schema lives in `/bench/repo/store/migration/{sqlite,mysql,postgres}/LATEST.sql` (plus versioned migration dirs `0.17` … onward). Tables in `LATEST.sql`: `system_setting`, `user`, `user_setting`, `memo`, `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `idp`, `inbox`, `reaction`, `memo_share`, `user_identity`.

## Persistent entity types

Each maps to a DB table:

| Entity type | Defined in | Table |
|---|---|---|
| `Memo` | `/bench/repo/store/memo.go` | `memo` |
| `MemoRelation` | `/bench/repo/store/memo_relation.go` | `memo_relation` |
| `MemoShare` | `/bench/repo/store/memo_share.go` | `memo_share` |
| `User` | `/bench/repo/store/user.go` | `user` |
| `UserSetting` | `/bench/repo/store/user_setting.go` | `user_setting` |
| `UserIdentity` | `/bench/repo/store/user_identity.go` | `user_identity` |
| `Attachment` | `/bench/repo/store/attachment.go` | `attachment` |
| `Inbox` | `/bench/repo/store/inbox.go` | `inbox` |
| `Reaction` | `/bench/repo/store/reaction.go` | `reaction` |
| `IdentityProvider` | `/bench/repo/store/idp.go` | `idp` |
| `InstanceSetting` | `/bench/repo/store/instance_setting.go` | `system_setting` |

Total: **11 persistent entity types.**

Notes:
- Each entity file also defines companion non-persistent helper structs (`Find*`, `Update*`, `Delete*`, e.g. `FindMemo`, `UpdateUser`) used as query/mutation parameter objects — these are not entities themselves.
- `auth_config.go` and `deployment_config.go` in the store package are configuration/aggregation logic layered on top of `IdentityProvider`/`InstanceSetting`, not separate tables.</result>
